subject: Aquarius: demo window relinquished after roadmap reprioritization
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aquaresearch.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro/demo slot week of 5/19 — Redwood inference overview

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation I put together a short agenda and a suggested demo slot next Tuesday, 5/20 at 10:00am PT. Agenda draft attached (AQUARIUS_MAP_v1.pdf).

Goals:
- Quick recap of your use case and constraints (data residency & latency targets)
- Live walkthrough of Redwood inference for short response flows (~64 tokens)
- Mutually agree on an initial evaluation checklist and next steps

If that time works I’ll send a calendar invite (30 min). If not, please propose two alternate slots and I’ll coordinate.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(r) 415-555-0193 | rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: AQUARIUS_MAP_v1.pdf
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aquaresearch.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro/demo slot week of 5/19 — Redwood inference overview

Rachel —

Appreciate the thoughtful agenda and the deck. Unfortunately, big update on our side: our product team has just locked the roadmap for the next two quarters and the LLM/inference exploration has been deprioritized in favor of a cross-platform analytics push. That means we need to pause new evaluation work for now.

Also, our PM leads are traveling the next three weeks for customer visits so coordination will be tough. I don’t want to waste your team’s time — please mark this demo window as relinquished for Aquarius.

That said:
- Can you keep us on a waitlist and share any lightweight eval materials we can use asynchronously?
- If there’s a condensed recording or short checklist we can review internally, send it over.

Thanks for understanding — I’ll reach back when we re-open this.

— Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product — Aquarius Research
lena.ortiz@aquaresearch.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aquaresearch.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro/demo slot week of 5/19 — Redwood inference overview

Hi Lena —

Totally understand — roadmap locks and travel make coordination painful. Thanks for the heads up. We’ll: 

1) Remove the 5/20 invite and mark the opportunity as on hold (RDW-2025-1934).
2) Share a 10-minute explainer video and a one‑page checklist you can circulate with the PMs — will drop links below.
3) Add Aquarius to our waitlist and ping you in mid-July for a quick sync (unless you re-open sooner).

Quick ask on our side: if it’s helpful, we can provide a short “impact sketch” calling out estimated latency and per-token cost for a 64-token flow vs. your in-house baseline — would your team be open to that as an asynchronous deliverable? No meetings required, just a short PDF.

I’ll get the materials to you by EOD and will also attach the calendar invite stub (aquarius-demo-invite.ics) so you have it for reference.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Links: https://drive.example.com/file/d/aq-map (explainer pdf), https://videos.example/redwood-10m-demo
Attachment: aquarius-demo-invite.ics
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aquarius — prospect deprioritized; next steps

Team — quick sync notes on Aquarius (RDW-2025-1934):

Summary: Aquarius has deprioritized LLM/inference in the near term due to a roadmap lock and upcoming PM travel. Demo window (5/20) relinquished. They asked for asynchronous materials and to be waitlisted.

Proposed next steps:
- Priyom: please prepare a short impact sketch (1 page) with latency and cost estimates for a 64-token inference flow. Keep it high-level and conservative. Target: 2 business days.
- Marcus: add Aquarius to the waitlist pipeline in HubSpot and schedule an automated mid-July recheck task. Link to deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/1934
- Monica: drop the 10m explainer recording and checklist into the shared Drive folder and grant view access to lena.ortiz@aquaresearch.com. Drive link: https://drive.example.com/file/d/aq-map

If they reopen earlier, we’ll prioritize a technical deep-dive. Otherwise, follow the waitlist cadence and no additional outreach for 6 weeks.

Thanks — I’ll own follow-ups with the buyer point once materials are live.

Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
